main.description: Copy a pending release's artifact again. A release is listed only once the registry has copied its artifact, which it tries once when it first indexes the release; this is how the release's publisher tries again after that copy failed. An active release is answered as it is, with nothing enqueued.

version.description: The version to retry, as published.

status.description: pending: the copy was enqueued again. active: the artifact is already held, and nothing was enqueued.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The caller's identity could not be determined.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The slug or version could not name a release.

errors.name: ReleaseNotFound
errors.description: That version is not published from the caller's account, or was withdrawn.

errors.name: ReleaseNotIndexed
errors.description: The registry has not indexed the release, so there is no copy to retry. It may have refused the record.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The copy could not be enqueued.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The registry has no identity configured.
